ValidationRule.description: Prevents moving a Quote out of 'Quote Rejected' status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Quote Rejected') && NOT ( ISPICKVAL (Status, 'Quote Rejected') )&& NOT (ISCHANGED (SkipValidations__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A rejected quote cannot be reverted!
